# lean-qr nano

`lean-qr-nano.mjs` is the unmodified `nano.mjs` from lean-qr 2.7.3, already used by the frontend.
Copyright David Evans, MIT; see `lean-qr-LICENSE`.
Upstream: https://github.com/davidje13/lean-qr

The server uses it to return a QR module matrix for watchOS SwiftUI rendering, without a third-party QR service or an additional npm runtime dependency.
